description: UIM Integration Automation — guided integration workflows, system landscape, destinations and automation

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Read
scopes.description: Read systems, destinations, scenarios, workflows, tasks and the execution log

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Execute
scopes.description: Run workflows and process tasks (start, complete, fail, skip, retry, assign)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Manage
scopes.description: Maintain systems, destinations, scenarios and task templates; test connections, purge the log

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Admin
scopes.description: Manage the user accounts of the built-in login (not used with XSUAA)

role-templates.name: IntegrationExpert
role-templates.description: Maintain the landscape and scenarios, run workflows
